De-risks tech by moving from build to run, a key step before commercial scale.
Provides real-world throughput to validate DLE/refining performance.
Outlines initial commercial scale that could drive future revenue.
External partner progressing cost estimates supports financing/readiness.
Lower impurities can reduce costs and improve yields versus peers.
